resume_company_heading: NOVELL, INC. – Provo, Utah & San Jose, California
roles_as_listed: Web Systems Architect, Global Technical Architecture Group, Information Technology
company_context: At the time, Novell was one of the largest and oldest independent software companies, with annual revenue of approximately $1 billion. Its products included the NetWare network operating system and Novell Directory Services identity management system.
summary_paragraphs: Migrated Novell’s corporate web infrastructure from a monolithic system to a redundant n-tier architecture supporting millions of hits per day. Architected the deployment of Novell’s direct-sales online store and deployed mission-critical web systems on pre-release Novell software. Partnered with software engineering teams to enable Novell’s operating system, directory, and application server to support enterprise web applications. Transformed Novell’s intranet from static pages into a business system supporting the daily work of its global workforce. The intranet received the 1999 CIO WebBusiness 50/50 Award, recognizing it as one of the top 50 corporate intranets.
